title: Test for a difference in outcome variances between treatment arms — difference_in_variances
text: stats::var.test(), classical F test ratio two variances. F test assumes outcome normally distributed within arm sensitive departures assumption, small p-value can reflect kurtosis rather difference dispersion. Levene- Bonett-type tests trade power robustness exactly . function previously called DescTools::VarTest(method = "bonett"), documented Bonett test never ran: VarTest() takes method argument two-sample branch, argument fell ... F test performed. Calling stats::var.test() directly gives numbers name describes . signature takes data first returns one row, DeclareDesign::label_estimator() expects estimator handler.
